grid: identical to heightfield.json: same dimensions, bboxCrsUnits, resolution and row order
rowOrientation: row 0 = north edge (ymax); row N-1 = south edge (ymin)

encoding.meaning: fraction of the pixel covered by glacier ice, 0 = none, 255 = full
encoding.quantisedTo: 16 levels, stored at PNG sample depth 4 and scaled x17 on decode

coverage.note: No slope attenuation is baked in - an icefall is steep by definition. The terrain shader keeps its own rock term for cliffs inside an outline.

source.modifications: Derived product, not the original data: the glacier outlines shipped in water.json were rasterised to the heightfield grid under the even-odd rule and stored as per-pixel ice coverage.
